title: Menopause and Diet: A UK Guide to Eating Well Through It
excerpt: 13 million UK women are currently peri or post menopausal. Here's what the evidence says about eating well through it.
author: Bite Insight Team
meta_title: Menopause and Diet: A UK Guide to Eating Well
meta_description: 13 million UK women are peri or post menopausal. A UK dietitian backed guide to bones, weight, heart health and hot flushes.
ai_summary: This guide explains how UK women can support their bodies through perimenopause and menopause with food. It covers protein and weight changes, bone and heart health, hot flush triggers like caffeine and alcohol, and the evidence behind soya and phytoestrogens. It draws on NHS, British Menopause Society and British Dietetic Association guidance.
